_readme: The map of the site (docs/ATELIER.md). Every page that is or was part of Globe Trotter: where its window sits on the world (x, y, w, h in world pixels — the world is 5200 wide, Zone left of 2600, Echo right of it; rot in degrees) and where its tag sits in the menu (tag: % from its side, % from the top, tilt). The pages of today keep what they are in site/js/world/layout.js; the versions of the past (era "past") are described here whole, and each is online or offline. The versions of the past are a private view: only the Atelier shows their windows and tags. Change it in the Atelier (?atelier=1), with `npm run layout`, or by hand; `npm run layout -- check` says whether it holds; `fire` publishes it.
